content.short: CoinJar is one of the world's longest-running crypto exchanges, trusted since 2013.
content.description: CoinJar offers transparent pricing for crypto trades: 0%–0.1% on CoinJar Exchange, 1% on the app for standard trades and recurring purchases, and 2% for Instant Buys via cards, Apple Pay, or Google Pay. Founded in 2013, CoinJar is among the world's longest-running crypto exchanges. It simplifies buying, selling, and managing crypto with features like recurring purchases, portfolio tracking, and fast transfers through local payment methods, helping users access crypto with clarity and confidence.
